name: VWO
summary: A/B testing and conversion optimization platform. Run experiments, heatmaps and personalization to lift conversions without developers.
best_for: teams that want an experience-optimisation platform (A/B testing + heatmaps + personalisation) with friendlier Bayesian stats and transparent pricing
skip_if: you're a small business wanting advanced targeting/MVT on the entry tier (you'll be priced up), or an enterprise running massive concurrent experiments: Optimizely handles that scale
honest_knock: The jump from Growth to Pro is steep (small businesses get priced out of MVT and complex targeting) and the UI is dense with options. Some users note the reporting breaks more often than pricier tools (though it doesn't affect the tests themselves). The part that costs people money later is what happens to a winner. VWO applies page changes through its SmartCode: their own page says the asynchronous SmartCode “loads page changes asynchronously when the web page loads” — so a variant left running in the editor is rendered by VWO rather than built into your site. Fine while you pay, gone when you stop. Their server-side testing changes the arithmetic here, because those changes live in your own stack; the client-side ones do not.

pricing.notes: No price is published any more, and the site has moved. Re-read on 20 September 2026: vwo.com now answers HTTP 301 and redirects to wingify.com — vwo.com/pricing/ to wingify.com/pricing/, vwo.com/free-trial/ to wingify.com/free-trial/ — and the pricing page is titled "Pricing & Plans | Wingify Platform", with the products named Wingify Testing, Wingify Personalization and Wingify Insights and a site-wide banner announcing that AB Tasty and VWO have united. The tier structure is unchanged: Growth, Pro and Enterprise as feature tables only, every button a Schedule a Demo, no currency amount anywhere in the rendered page and none in wingify.com/llms.txt either — the same picture as the 4 and 10 September 2026 readings. The ~$314/mo for 10k MTUs this dossier carried until 4 September 2026 was a published figure the vendor has since withdrawn. Two things are new on the page. A per-MAU meter is now visible in the comparison table — 50, 100 and 200 events stored per MAU across the tiers — under the vendor's own footnote that the limit is not implemented in the app, is representational, does not affect current pricing and will apply in future to all customers on their respective plans. And API access at Enterprise is now listed with a rate limit of 60K a month. Wandz, the AI layer the 10 September reading found sold in Core and Advanced tiers, is no longer named on the pricing page. The tier lines are unchanged: multivariate testing, guardrail metrics, advanced targeting and downloadable reports start at Pro; API access, SSO, mutually exclusive groups and a dedicated CSM only at Enterprise. Re-read on 23 November 2026 from our EU server: still no amount anywhere on wingify.com/pricing/ or in wingify.com/llms.txt. Growth, Pro and Enterprise are still feature tables with Schedule a Demo on every tier, the events-per-MAU footnote still says the limit "has not been implemented on the app, is representational, and does not affect current pricing", and Enterprise API access is still listed with a rate limit of 60K a month. The AI layer now goes by Wingz AI: the FAQ says Wingz Core is included for free with every paid Wingify product and that advanced AI features sit in a paid plan, Wingz Advanced, and paid add-ons, again without a price.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested VWO, which is now sold under the name Wingify, on a 30-day free trial of an account we created. The trial started without a card, and a draft A/B test with two variations on a neutral test page stood after about 3 minutes. The visual editor opened in fallback mode and could not edit a variation until the SmartCode sits on the site, so a real test needs that code first. Inside the trial the Growth plan has a list price of $1,118 per month billed annually, $13,410 up front, with a self-service checkout, while the public pricing page still shows no amount. The confirm page was left before Checkout Now. Account and start: we created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser, in its own tab, on 19 November 2026 from 09:41 to 09:50 CET. The interface was in English. The product is now sold as Wingify: vwo.com/pricing forwards to wingify.com/pricing, which says AB Tasty and VWO have united, and the app is called Wingify, while the demo still calls itself VWO Playground. The dossier name is VWO and the review is on AIBM (b2b/vwo-review). The welcome screen offered two routes, Explore Wingify Playground (a live demo with no setup) and Continue account Setup, plus an optional Talk to an expert. The Playground opened as a separate demo account after about 25 seconds. Back in the real account, Select your products listed Web Experimentation & Rollout, Web Personalization, Feature Management, Journey Analytics, Behavior Analytics and User Feedback, each with Start free trial. Core action, an A/B test on one page: Start free trial on Web Experimentation & Rollout at 09:44 gave a 30-day trial at once, with a bar 30 days remaining, Upgrade; no card, no phone number and no call were asked. Basic Setup asked for a first website; the prefilled domain was replaced by the neutral https://example.com, and Add domain said Domain added successfully. SmartCode generated, with setup guides for HTML, Next.js, WordPress, Shopify, Wix and others. The code was not copied or placed anywhere. Web Experimentation, Create, AB - Single Page: the test Test Project headline test on https://example.com/ with Control and Variation 1 at 50/50 and 100% traffic. Metrics and Targeting exist as later steps and were not filled in; the test was not started. Launch Editor asked to save first and opened the editor in a new tab with the message Page opened in fallback mode, which advises the SmartCode or the Wingify Chrome extension. The page loaded, but elements could not be selected (a double click only marked one word), so a variation could not be edited without the code or the extension. Heatmaps, recordings, forms and surveys were only seen in the Playground demo with sample data, not with our own traffic; a sample test there showed 701 conversions from 4,553 visitors against 541 from 4,476. That is demo data and says nothing about a test on a real site. Time: about 3 minutes from the trial start to a draft test with two variations in the editor (09:44 to 09:47), not counting the 25 seconds the Playground took to load. Trial limits on My Subscription: Web Experimentation & Rollout on Free trial, MTU consumed 0 of 10K, expires on Dec 19, 2026, 30 days left; Wingz on Free trial with 0 of 6.0K credits; Websites 1 out of 1. Data is kept for 13 months according to the app. Plans: In the trial account, Upgrade, Web Experimentation & Rollout, with a slider for Monthly Tracked Users from 25K to 5M+ (default 100K): Trial, Full access to all product features, Free, active with 30 days remaining; Growth, For small businesses, $1,363 struck through, Save 18%, $1,118 per month, billed annually, with Add and Contact Sales; Pro, For mid sized businesses, and Enterprise, For large teams, agencies & enterprises, both Request pricing. Add-ons: Social Proof & Urgency Messaging $599 per month (Pro, Enterprise), Mutually Exclusive Groups $299 per month (Growth, Pro, Enterprise) and Additional MTU Quota $199 one time, ending with the plan. Wingz AI has Core, included with paid plans, and Advanced options. The FAQ in the same app says "Wingify offers custom pricing tailored to your needs" and asks you to reach out for a quote. The public pricing page vwo.com/pricing now forwards to wingify.com/pricing and shows Growth, Pro and Enterprise, each with Schedule a Demo and no amount; its sign-up box says Free for 30 days. No credit card required. Checkout: Add on Growth opened a Checkout Summary with Growth, 100,000 MTU, $1,118 per month, billed annually, Grand Total $13,410. View Summary opened Review & confirm, step 2 of 3, with Total $13,410, a Checkout Now button and the switch Auto-renew on Nov 19, 2027 is enabled until you cancel; the page also says the new plan replaces the current one at once. Checkout Now was not clicked; no card field was seen and nothing was paid. $1,118 times 12 is $13,416, so the monthly figure is rounded. A last Remove click on the cart had no visible effect, so the cart may still hold Growth; nothing was bought. Cancelling: the trial ends by itself on Dec 19, 2026, so there was nothing to cancel. Settings, Subscription & Invoices has My Subscription, Invoice History and Billing Profile; a paid plan renews automatically until you cancel. A delete account button was not looked for. Not tested: editing a variation in the editor, verifying the SmartCode, starting a test, our own heatmaps or recordings, the prices of Pro and Enterprise, the prices at 25K or 50K MTU, Billing Profile and deleting the account. Clean up: the account, the Playground demo account, the domain example.com and the draft test (campaign 1, Draft) stay; the cart may still hold Growth. The own tab and the editor tab were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The visual editor needs the SmartCode on your site or the Chrome extension; without it the page opens in fallback mode and you cannot select elements, so the trial does little until a developer places the code. The brand is changing from VWO to Wingify, and the app FAQ says pricing is custom while the plan table in the same app shows a Growth price. Growth is billed for a year up front and renews automatically.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested VWO, which is now sold under the name Wingify, on a 30-day free trial of an account we created. The trial started without a card, and a draft A/B test with two variations on a neutral test page stood after about 3 minutes. The visual editor opened in fallback mode and could not edit a variation until the SmartCode sits on the site, so a real test needs that code first. Inside the trial the Growth plan has a list price of $1,118 per month billed annually, $13,410 up front, with a self-service checkout, while the public pricing page still shows no amount. The confirm page was left before Checkout Now. Account and start: we created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser, in its own tab, on 19 November 2026 from 09:41 to 09:50 CET. The interface was in English. The product is now sold as Wingify: vwo.com/pricing forwards to wingify.com/pricing, which says AB Tasty and VWO have united, and the app is called Wingify, while the demo still calls itself VWO Playground. The dossier name is VWO and the review is on AIBM (b2b/vwo-review). The welcome screen offered two routes, Explore Wingify Playground (a live demo with no setup) and Continue account Setup, plus an optional Talk to an expert. The Playground opened as a separate demo account after about 25 seconds. Back in the real account, Select your products listed Web Experimentation & Rollout, Web Personalization, Feature Management, Journey Analytics, Behavior Analytics and User Feedback, each with Start free trial. Core action, an A/B test on one page: Start free trial on Web Experimentation & Rollout at 09:44 gave a 30-day trial at once, with a bar 30 days remaining, Upgrade; no card, no phone number and no call were asked. Basic Setup asked for a first website; the prefilled domain was replaced by the neutral https://example.com, and Add domain said Domain added successfully. SmartCode generated, with setup guides for HTML, Next.js, WordPress, Shopify, Wix and others. The code was not copied or placed anywhere. Web Experimentation, Create, AB - Single Page: the test Test Project headline test on https://example.com/ with Control and Variation 1 at 50/50 and 100% traffic. Metrics and Targeting exist as later steps and were not filled in; the test was not started. Launch Editor asked to save first and opened the editor in a new tab with the message Page opened in fallback mode, which advises the SmartCode or the Wingify Chrome extension. The page loaded, but elements could not be selected (a double click only marked one word), so a variation could not be edited without the code or the extension. Heatmaps, recordings, forms and surveys were only seen in the Playground demo with sample data, not with our own traffic; a sample test there showed 701 conversions from 4,553 visitors against 541 from 4,476. That is demo data and says nothing about a test on a real site. Time: about 3 minutes from the trial start to a draft test with two variations in the editor (09:44 to 09:47), not counting the 25 seconds the Playground took to load. Trial limits on My Subscription: Web Experimentation & Rollout on Free trial, MTU consumed 0 of 10K, expires on Dec 19, 2026, 30 days left; Wingz on Free trial with 0 of 6.0K credits; Websites 1 out of 1. Data is kept for 13 months according to the app. Plans: In the trial account, Upgrade, Web Experimentation & Rollout, with a slider for Monthly Tracked Users from 25K to 5M+ (default 100K): Trial, Full access to all product features, Free, active with 30 days remaining; Growth, For small businesses, $1,363 struck through, Save 18%, $1,118 per month, billed annually, with Add and Contact Sales; Pro, For mid sized businesses, and Enterprise, For large teams, agencies & enterprises, both Request pricing. Add-ons: Social Proof & Urgency Messaging $599 per month (Pro, Enterprise), Mutually Exclusive Groups $299 per month (Growth, Pro, Enterprise) and Additional MTU Quota $199 one time, ending with the plan. Wingz AI has Core, included with paid plans, and Advanced options. The FAQ in the same app says "Wingify offers custom pricing tailored to your needs" and asks you to reach out for a quote. The public pricing page vwo.com/pricing now forwards to wingify.com/pricing and shows Growth, Pro and Enterprise, each with Schedule a Demo and no amount; its sign-up box says Free for 30 days. No credit card required. Checkout: Add on Growth opened a Checkout Summary with Growth, 100,000 MTU, $1,118 per month, billed annually, Grand Total $13,410. View Summary opened Review & confirm, step 2 of 3, with Total $13,410, a Checkout Now button and the switch Auto-renew on Nov 19, 2027 is enabled until you cancel; the page also says the new plan replaces the current one at once. Checkout Now was not clicked; no card field was seen and nothing was paid. $1,118 times 12 is $13,416, so the monthly figure is rounded. A last Remove click on the cart had no visible effect, so the cart may still hold Growth; nothing was bought. Cancelling: the trial ends by itself on Dec 19, 2026, so there was nothing to cancel. Settings, Subscription & Invoices has My Subscription, Invoice History and Billing Profile; a paid plan renews automatically until you cancel. A delete account button was not looked for. Not tested: editing a variation in the editor, verifying the SmartCode, starting a test, our own heatmaps or recordings, the prices of Pro and Enterprise, the prices at 25K or 50K MTU, Billing Profile and deleting the account. Clean up: the account, the Playground demo account, the domain example.com and the draft test (campaign 1, Draft) stay; the cart may still hold Growth. The own tab and the editor tab were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The visual editor needs the SmartCode on your site or the Chrome extension; without it the page opens in fallback mode and you cannot select elements, so the trial does little until a developer places the code. The brand is changing from VWO to Wingify, and the app FAQ says pricing is custom while the plan table in the same app shows a Growth price. Growth is billed for a year up front and renews automatically.
